rows.text: If we could just collect everyone's data, surely we'd be able to piece together the perfect "idol." When an executive at Interastral Peace Entertainment had this idea, the Behavioral Data Modeling and Personality Fit Protocol started popping up in every corner of the universe. By signing it, you surrender your privacy and upload your entire life trail to the IPC. The Intelligentsia Guild then feeds this data to computers, using big data to create a perfect idol that caters to everyone's tastes. Countless residents have signed since the Worlds Reborn Initiative kicked off, yet that perfect idol is still nowhere to be found. Maybe the sample size is too small, or maybe the idea of "pleasing everyone" is just a paradox.
